This outpost is the staging-area for the [[elite mission]] of the same name. The [[party]] can have up to 12 [[character]]s and [[hero]]es.

This area functions as a lobby for organizing parties.

==Getting there==
* Usage of a [[Passage Scroll to Urgoz's Warren]].
* Talking to [[Vash]].
** Members of the [[alliance]] that [[Kurzick-Luxon border|controls]] [[House zu Heltzer]] can talk to him in House zu Heltzer. A player who does not belong to that alliance can be [[Ferry|ferried]] there by a player who does.
*** Ferry can also be provided so long as your character had been there before. The provider will enter their [[guild hall]] (and send you a guest invitation if possible and necessary) and ask you to join their party. Then the provider will click "Leave Guild Hall" ([[Guild Menu]] button) to transport you back together.
** During Factions Elite [[Weekly bonuses|weekly bonus]], he also appears in [[Kaineng Center]] and any character can talk to him.
